description: If a retained application represents an input tuple, the specified function map at that tuple equals that application’s class.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.functionMap_of_represented.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) (hE : E ⊆ S.product S)
  (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.SubtermClosed S) {n : ℕ} (f : L.Functions n)
  (xs : Fin n → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.Carrier S E hE)
  (a : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.ApplicationWitness S E hE ⋯ f xs) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.functionMap S E hE ⋯ f xs =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.classOf S E hE (FirstOrder.Language.func f a.terms) ⋯
